name: comp-389
blurb: Product tour that anchors a popover to different grid items, cycling through steps on click.
description: Interactive tour that shows a grid of numbered cards. Clicking 'Start tour' opens a popover anchored to the active card, cycling through tour steps.
use_when: Product tours that highlight multiple elements on the page and explain each one.
avoid_when: Mobile or responsive layouts where card positions shift.
a11y: Grid is not labeled; popover is not keyboard-accessible.
